subject: Banking
title: How Bankers Actually Spend Their Days
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: How Bankers Actually Spend Their Days.

hook.text: Junior investment bankers work 80-100 hours per week building financial models and pitch decks. The hours are legendary.

buildup.text: Analysts build spreadsheet models that value companies. Associates refine them.

discovery.text: A pitch book is a presentation selling the bank's services to a potential client.

twist.text: Goldman Sachs capped junior hours at 80 per week in 2021 after burnout deaths. The cap is widely considered unenforced.

climax.text: Investment banking trades extreme hours for extreme pay. First-year analysts earn $200,000+.

punchline.text: 80-100 hours weekly, $200K starting pay. The grind is the product.

quiz.question: What do junior investment banking analysts primarily do?
options: Build financial models and pitch decks
